title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 6: the floating ax head, the Syrian army struck with blindness and the famine in besieged Samaria.

questions.text: What fell into the water while one of the sons of the prophets was cutting down a tree?
questions.explanation: As one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water, and he cried out that it was borrowed.

questions.text: How did Elisha make the iron float?
questions.explanation: Elisha cut down a stick, threw it in where the ax head had fallen, and made the iron float.

answers.text: He cut down a stick and threw it in
He struck the water with his mantle
He poured salt into the river
He stretched out his hand over it

questions.text: According to one of his servants, what did Elisha tell the king of Israel?
questions.explanation: A servant said that Elisha tells the king of Israel the words that the king of Syria speaks in his bedroom.

answers.text: The number of the Syrian chariots
The names of the Syrian captains
The day the Syrians would attack Samaria
The words the king of Syria spoke in his bedroom

questions.text: In which city was Elisha when the king of Syria sent an army to get him?
questions.explanation: The king of Syria was told that Elisha was in Dothan, so he sent horses, chariots and a great army, and they surrounded the city.

questions.text: What did Elisha's servant see when Yahweh opened his eyes?
questions.explanation: Yahweh opened the young man's eyes, and the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

answers.text: The mountain full of horses and chariots of fire
An angel standing with a drawn sword
The Syrian army fleeing in fear
A pillar of fire in front of the city

questions.text: What did Elisha ask Yahweh to do to the Syrians who came down to him?
questions.explanation: Elisha prayed, 'Please strike this people with blindness,' and Yahweh struck them with blindness.

answers.text: Send fire on them from heaven

questions.text: To which city did Elisha lead the blinded Syrians?
questions.explanation: Elisha led them to Samaria, and when Yahweh opened their eyes they were in the middle of Samaria.

questions.text: What did Elisha tell the king of Israel to do with the Syrian captives?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'You shall not strike them,' but set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink and go to their master.

answers.text: Strike them down with the sword
Set bread and water before them and let them go
Keep them as servants in Samaria
Send them to the king of Judah

questions.text: During the famine in Samaria, for how much was a donkey's head sold?
questions.explanation: There was a great famine in Samaria until a donkey's head was sold for eighty pieces of silver.

questions.text: What did the people see the king wearing underneath on his body?
questions.explanation: When the king tore his clothes on the wall, the people looked and saw that he had sackcloth underneath on his body.
